Were both sides of your face affected equally?

Did the episode begin suddenly today?

Have you recently received Botox, cosmetic injections, dental treatment, or another facial procedure?
Have you used any recreational drugs or been exposed to toxic chemicals recently?
Did you have a severe headache, fever, or neck stiffness with the episode?
Have you had any recent head injury?
Are you pregnant or possibly pregnant?
